### Target of Change
> Specify the target of change: Docker, CI/CD, model serving (API/batch), data pipeline scheduler, environment variables (.env), GPU/resource configuration, etc.

### Reason for Change
> Why is the change needed?

### Scope of Impact
> Which services/containers/environments (training/inference/data collection) are affected? Does it impact model version management/reproducibility?

### Rollback Plan
> How to revert if a problem occurs (including restoring a previous model version/image).

### Checklist
- [ ] Verified in staging environment
- [ ] Data/model version compatibility confirmed
- [ ] Team notified
